error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Velux Active service.
error.pairing_failed: Gateway pairing failed. Make sure Home Assistant is on the same network as the gateway. If the gateway LED is flashing, press the gateway button and try the key retrieval step again.

user.description: Log in with your Velux Active with Netatmo app details.
user.title: Velux Active with Netatmo

keys.description: Enter your window signing keys to enable full control of roof windows (open, close, set position, stop). These are optional — roller shutters and blinds work without them. See the integration documentation for instructions on obtaining your keys.
keys.title: Window Signing Keys (optional)

pairing_method.description: Signing keys enable full roof-window control. Choose whether Home Assistant should pair directly with the gateway or whether you want to enter existing keys manually.
pairing_method.title: Window Signing Keys

select_gateway.description: Select the VELUX gateway to pair with for roof-window signing keys.
select_gateway.title: Select Gateway

pair.description: Enter the local IP address or hostname of your VELUX gateway, then press Submit. Home Assistant will ask the VELUX cloud service to put the gateway into pairing mode. Wait for the gateway LED to start flashing before pressing the physical gateway button.

data_description.gateway_host: Home Assistant must be able to reach this host on TCP port 25050 during pairing.

pair.title: Start Gateway Pairing

pair_button.description: Now press the physical button on the VELUX gateway while its LED is flashing. Then press Submit here so Home Assistant can retrieve the signing keys from the local gateway.
pair_button.title: Authorize Gateway Pairing

error.pairing_failed: Gateway pairing failed. Make sure Home Assistant is on the same network as the gateway. If the gateway LED is flashing, press the gateway button and try the key retrieval step again.
